comparisons.peer_topic: Diversity, Belonging and Inclusion (DB&I) Philosophy and Strategy
comparisons.peer_summary: AMD believes that building a diverse talent pipeline, encouraging a culture of respect and belonging, and increasing inclusion of unique voices strengthens the company. This approach includes fostering an environment where employees share diverse opinions and perspectives.
comparisons.comparison: Both Intel and AMD describe their culture as inclusive and emphasize the strategic value of diversity, though Intel frames it around empowerment and accountability while AMD focuses on respecting unique voices. Intel states, "Fostering a culture of empowerment, inclusion, and accountability is also core to our strategy," whereas AMD believes that "building a diverse talent pipeline, encouraging a culture of respect and belonging, and increasing inclusion of unique and underrepresented voices makes our company stronger."

sentences.text: Fostering a culture of empowerment, inclusion, and accountability is also core to our strategy.
We believe that building a diverse talent pipeline, encouraging a culture of respect and belonging, and increasing inclusion of unique and underrepresented voices makes our company stronger.

comparisons.peer_topic: Employee Culture and Engagement Survey Results
comparisons.peer_summary: AMD conducts annual global workforce surveys to measure culture and engagement; the 2024 survey results were among the best for global tech companies, with employees describing the culture as inclusive and innovative and engagement ratings in the top 10% of peers.
comparisons.comparison: While Intel articulates a philosophical commitment to an inclusive workplace for engineers, AMD provides empirical validation of a positive culture through its annual survey results, reporting high engagement and inclusivity ratings. Intel claims it is "committed to creating an inclusive workplace where the world's best engineers and technologists can fulfill their dreams," while AMD states, "Our employees described our culture as inclusive, innovative, open, and respectful... and employment engagement is among the top 10% of our high-performing technology industry peers."

sentences.text: We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where the world's best engineers and technologists can fulfill their dreams and create technology that improves the life of every person on the planet.

Our employees described our culture as inclusive, innovative, open, and respectful, and rated the quality of our managers high, and employment engagement is among the top 10% of our high-performing technology industry peers.

comparisons.peer_summary: The company has established five diversity, equality, and inclusion (DEI) commitments covering hiring, pay, culture, financial institutions, and supplier diversity, with each commitment assigned an executive sponsor for strategy and execution.
comparisons.comparison: Both Intel and Micron explicitly link their workplace culture to inclusion commitments, with Micron detailing specific governance structures to enforce these values. Intel affirms, "Fostering a culture of empowerment, inclusion, and accountability is also core to our strategy," while Micron highlights, "We have five diversity, equality, and inclusion ("DEI") commitments that serve as the roadmap of our DEI work internally... each commitment is assigned an executive sponsor who is responsible for its strategy and execution."

comparisons.peer_topic: Diversity and Inclusion Philosophy and Initiatives
comparisons.peer_summary: The company believes diverse teams fuel innovation and is committed to an inclusive culture, striving to build a diverse talent pipeline that includes underrepresented groups such as women and Black/African American or Hispanic/Latino candidates through partnerships, dedicated recruiting, leadership development, training, and measurement of equity metrics.
comparisons.comparison: Both Intel and NVIDIA explicitly connect their commitment to an inclusive culture with the goal of driving innovation and attracting top talent. Intel states, "Fostering a culture of empowerment, inclusion, and accountability is also core to our strategy," while NVIDIA believes that "diverse teams fuel innovation, and we are committed to creating an inclusive culture that supports all employees."

sentences.text: Fostering a culture of empowerment, inclusion, and accountability is also core to our strategy.
We believe that diverse teams fuel innovation, and we are committed to creating an inclusive culture that supports all employees.

comparisons.peer_summary: Qualcomm focuses DEI efforts on inspiring innovation through inclusive culture, recruiting diverse talent, and identifying strategic partners, supported by global employee network groups and engagement with diverse communities.
comparisons.comparison: Both Intel and Qualcomm view an inclusive workforce as essential to their success and innovation, though Qualcomm further details its focus on recruiting diverse talent and employee network groups. Intel is "committed to creating an inclusive workplace where the world's best engineers and technologists can fulfill their dreams," while Qualcomm states, "We believe that a diverse workforce is important to our success, and we continue to focus on making Qualcomm a great place to work for everyone... Our recent efforts have been focused in three areas: inspiring innovation through an inclusive and diverse culture..."

sentences.text: We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where the world's best engineers and technologists can fulfill their dreams and create technology that improves the life of every person on the planet.
We believe that a diverse workforce is important to our success, and we continue to focus on making Qualcomm a great place to work for everyone, including women and underrepresented populations.

Our recent efforts have been focused in three areas: inspiring innovation through an inclusive and diverse culture; expanding our efforts to recruit world-class diverse talent; and identifying strategic partners to accelerate our programs.
